headword: {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}

definitions.gloss: athletic ability; physical fitness; motor skills
definitions.explanation: The ability to perform physical activities effectively. Encompasses coordination, speed, strength, endurance, and other physical capabilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Children's motor skills develop with age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: According to a recent survey, children's physical fitness is reportedly declining.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (exercise, movement) and ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability, capacity). Frequently appears in discussions about sports, education, and child development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ — to have high/low athletic ability
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧ — to have excellent athletic ability
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ — fitness test
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧ — improvement of athletic ability
- {運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧ — decline in physical fitness

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧ — physical strength/stamina (more about endurance and raw physical power)
- ⟦{運動神経|うんどうしんけい}→運動神経：14888_undoushinkei⟧ — motor coordination; colloquially used to mean "being good/bad at sports"
- {身体能力|しんたいのうりょく} — physical ability (broader, includes non-sport contexts)

USAGE:
In Japanese schools, students take ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ ({運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧) — standardized fitness tests measuring grip strength, flexibility, running speed, and other metrics. Results are tracked nationally, and declining scores are a topic of public concern.
